answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a dawn as the anchor of the cost.
